short_description:
Where to get a haircut in GTA 6: the closest barber to Jason's house is Barnacle Beauties in southern Key Lento, next door to The Siren's Chest. Newer guides count 18 hair and beauty salons in total, including Kurt's Barber Shop in Hamlet, Salon Pérez in Little Cuba and Hair By Clair in Capri (an older guide lists 7). No story spoilers.

Sources: Sportskeeda, PowerPyx, TheClick, GTABase.

Every spot is pinned on our interactive map at vicereplay.com (Guides).
